mainEntity.name: What does a foreclosed property kitchen refresh usually include?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with inspection, then cleaning and removal, then repairs, and finally cosmetic upgrades like cabinet refinishing, paint, hardware, and flooring touch-ups. For foreclosed properties, documentation matters too, so photos and itemized notes help track what was found and completed.
acceptedAnswer.description: It usually includes inspection, cleanout, repairs, and cosmetic updates. In foreclosed homes, photo documentation and a clear removal log are often part of the job.
